body: 🤯 LobeHub - Super-Agents on Your Team. Add super-agents to the chats your team already uses.They take on work by themselves and get better every week.
plain_description: **Put AI agents to work in your team’s chats.** They can take on tasks, work in parallel, and build expertise over time. Self-host it or use LobeHub Cloud.
technical_description: LobeHub is an AI agent workspace that connects agents, models, and messaging apps. It supports agents working together on tasks, a marketplace for agents, MCP servers, and skills, and self-hosting with Docker Compose or deployment platforms such as Vercel. The README also lists web, desktop, and mobile apps.
title: LobeHub
